text.en: The sitios of Bulanit, East Tawagan Norte and Dalapang in the Municipality of Labangan, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Balaniog.

The sitios of Lower Pulacan, Limpang Proper, West Limpang, Waterfalls and Lantawan in the Municipality of Labangan, same province, are constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Pulacan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1960.
